events.title: UNRWA work and mandate in ‘jeopardy’, Guterres warns
events.summary: The UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine refugees (UNRWA) continues to operate under “extraordinary pressure”, UN Secretary-General António Guterres said on Thursday.

events.title: Displacement on the rise in Yemen as fighting continues
events.summary: As hostilities worsen in Yemen, more people have been fleeing their homes, further intensifying the humanitarian crisis within the region, the UN Refugee Agency (UNHCR) warned on Tuesday.

events.title: UN condemns attempted Houthi strike on Riyadh as Yemen displacement surges past 130,000
events.summary: The UN has condemned continued cross‑border attacks by Houthi forces against Saudi Arabia, including an attempted strike on the capital Riyadh, as fighting inside Yemen drives one of the country’s fastest displacement surges in years.
